name.en: UK visa / permission digital face photo
name.zh: 英国签证或许可数字面部照片

notes.en: UKVI guidance (published 12 February 2026): colour JPG/JPEG; at least 600×750 pixels; 50 KB–6 MB; vertically oriented; not mirrored. Plain light-coloured background (hex not named; #FFFFFF stored as a default). Must show head, shoulders and upper body; not a scan of another photo or of the passport image. Print millimetres, DPI, and head ratio are not stated. 6 MB is recorded as 6144 KB (1024-based).
notes.zh: UKVI 指引（2026-02-12）：彩色 JPG/JPEG；至少 600×750 像素；50 KB–6 MB；竖向、不可镜像。浅色纯背景（未给色值，默认记 #FFFFFF）。须含头、肩与上身；不得翻拍其他照片或护照页。未写印刷毫米、DPI 与头部比例。6 MB 记为 6144 KB。

sources.title: GOV.UK: Take a photo of your face for a visa application or permission
